issues.current_text: mais de 30 funcionários da OpenAI e Google — incluindo Jeff Dean — assinaram um amicus brief defendendo a Anthropic contra o Pentágono, que classificou a empresa como risco na cadeia de suprimentos. A Anthropic estima perder até US$ 5 bilhões
issues.previous_text: A Anthropic abriu dois processos federais contra o Pentágono por ter sido classificada como 'risco à cadeia de suprimentos de segurança nacional'... nomeiam quase três dúzias de réus incluindo o secretário de Defesa Pete Hegseth
issues.suggestion: The Anthropic-Pentagon dispute was the lead story on 03-09. Today's angle (amicus brief from rivals, $5B loss estimate) adds new developments but rehashes the 'supply chain risk' designation extensively. Trim the background context readers already know and focus strictly on the new detail: rivals defending Anthropic and the financial estimate.

issues.current_text: a subsidiária chinesa da Nexperia começou a produzir chips em wafers de 12 polegadas — tamanho que a matriz holandesa não consegue fabricar na Europa — aprofundando a fratura com a controladora Wingtech após o governo dos Países Baixos intervir
issues.previous_text: Na disputa Nexperia, a Wingtech busca $8 bilhões em compensação após o bloqueio de contas de funcionários chineses.
issues.suggestion: Nexperia appeared on 03-08 (Wingtech $8B compensation) and 03-07 (Holland disabling Chinese employee accounts, China warning of global chip shortages). This is the third consecutive edition covering this dispute. Today's angle (12-inch wafer production) is genuinely new. Keep the new fact but cut the recap about 'the Netherlands government intervening' — readers have already seen that context twice.

issues.current_text: Macron despachou o porta-aviões Charles de Gaulle com oito fragatas para liderar missão naval europeia de escolta de petroleiros
issues.previous_text: Macron anunciou de Chipre uma missão naval europeia para escoltar petroleiros pelo Estreito de Hormuz assim que a 'fase quente' terminar — a primeira ação militar europeia independente no conflito.
issues.suggestion: Macron's naval escort mission was covered on 03-09 as an announcement. Today's text upgrades it to 'dispatched the Charles de Gaulle', which is a new development. However, the framing is nearly identical ('missão naval europeia de escolta de petroleiros'). Rewrite to emphasize the escalation from announcement to deployment without repeating the premise.

issues.current_text: O WTI oscilou de US$ 120 para US$ 85 no mesmo dia... O S&P 500 abriu em queda de 1,5% e fechou em alta de 0,8%
issues.previous_text: Brent a $119,50/barril (+66% desde 28 de fevereiro), o Nikkei desabou 7%, futuros do Dow caíram 1.011 pontos
issues.suggestion: Oil prices and market volatility have been a recurring element across all four editions (03-07: $90/barrel; 03-08: $92.69; 03-09: $119.50; 03-10: $120→$85). Today's angle — extreme intraday swing — is new and interesting, but consider acknowledging the trajectory briefly ('after days of relentless climbs, oil reversed') instead of presenting the price as if readers haven't been tracking it.

issues.current_text: A guerra EUA-Irã entrou no 11º dia. Hegseth prometeu 'o dia mais intenso de ataques'... Irã ameaçou bloquear cada litro de petróleo... Trânsito no Estreito de Hormuz caiu de ~100 navios/dia para 2-3
issues.previous_text: Pela primeira vez na história, o Estreito de Hormuz e o Mar Vermelho estão simultaneamente fechados ao tráfego comercial
issues.suggestion: The Strait of Hormuz closure has been covered on 03-08 and 03-09 already. Today adds the specific '100 ships/day to 2-3' stat, which is vivid and new, but the overall Iran-war-oil-Hormuz paragraph structure repeats the same beats (attack escalation + oil threat + Hormuz chokepoint). Consider restructuring: lead with what's genuinely new today (Hegseth's '5,000 targets', Iran's total oil blockade threat, the Russia sanctions waiver) and fold the Hormuz stat in as supporting detail rather than re-establishing the premise.

issues.previous_text: risco à cadeia de suprimentos de segurança nacional
issues.suggestion: This exact phrase ('risco à/na cadeia de suprimentos') appears in both editions. Since the designation was explained in detail on 03-09, today's mention can use a shorter reference like 'a designação do Pentágono' or 'o veto militar' without repeating the supply-chain terminology.

Both are punchy one-sentence closers at the end of paragraphs within the same edition — a structural tic. The newsletter uses these staccato summary sentences frequently. Consider varying the rhythm: use a question, a longer reflection, or simply let the facts speak without the editorial punchline in at least one of these spots.

issues.current_text: Enquanto LeCun busca alternativas aos LLMs, o resto da indústria acelera o status quo.
issues.previous_text: A mesma Anthropic, enquanto perde contratos militares, lançou o Anthropic Marketplace
issues.suggestion: The 'enquanto X faz uma coisa, Y faz o oposto' juxtaposition device is a recurring structural move across editions. On 03-07 it was 'the same Anthropic, while losing military contracts, launched the Marketplace.' On 03-10 it's 'while LeCun seeks alternatives, the rest of the industry accelerates the status quo.' Vary the transition — try a direct contrast ('LeCun bets against LLMs. Everyone else doubles down.') or simply sequence the items without the adversative connector.

issues.current_text: Do outro lado... Rivais se unindo contra o governo: esse é o nível de alerta.
issues.previous_text: A pesquisadora Ajeya Cotra da METR disse que suas projeções anteriores são 'conservadoras demais'.
issues.suggestion: The newsletter frequently uses an authoritative one-line editorial judgment to close a paragraph ('esse é o nível de alerta', 'nada é acidental' on 03-07, 'a volatilidade é a mensagem' today). This editorial voice is part of the brand, but three instances in a single edition (03-10) plus recurring use across editions makes it feel formulaic. Limit to one such line per edition, placed at the most impactful moment.

issues.current_text: taxistas de black cab chamam a iniciativa de 'solução em busca de um problema.'
issues.previous_text: India Today chamou de 'a singularidade começa agora'.
issues.suggestion: Closing a tech section with a quote from a skeptic/outsider is a device used across editions (03-09: India Today's 'singularity starts now' quote to close the Karpathy section; 03-10: black cab drivers dismissing robotaxis). Both serve as ironic commentary. Consider varying the technique — close with a data point or a forward-looking question instead of a colorful quote every time.

summary: Moderate repetition: 5 recurring stories (Anthropic-Pentagon, Nexperia, Macron naval mission, oil/Hormuz, Iran war context) and several structural/phrasing patterns (adversative 'enquanto' transitions, punchy editorial one-liners, closing quotes from outsiders). New angles exist for most stories but background context is being re-explained too heavily.
